newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco launches tender to upgrade Fez water grid.
newsitem.headline: Morocco launches tender to upgrade Fez water grid.

text.p: Morocco launched an international tender to upgrade the central Fez city's water and waste grid, the interior ministry said on Saturday.
The Moroccan government, which received substantial funds from the World Bank, invites firms to subscribe to "projects of upgrading Fez water and waste network", the ministry said in a statement.
The tender closing date was set for August 4, 1997.
Only firms of World Bank country members, Switzerland, Taiwan and China are allowed to take part in the tender, the ministry added.
Located near the Atlas mountains, Fez has an active edible oil and leather industry but its water and waste installations are old.
